name: lsc-tig-awards tig_2021
description: LSC Technology Initiative Grant (TIG) round 2021 as printed on LSC's 2021 project description page (amounts to the cent, in two sections: Technology Initiative Grant awards and Technology Improvement Project awards), each grant matched by hand to the amount LSC's 17 November 2021 press release prints for it, with LSC's own counts and dollar figures for the round and the cumulative 'since the program's inception' figures in LSC's TIG releases of 2020-2025. Read from the raw text of each document and hand-checked. Compiled by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents working in his name. CC BY 4.0.

fields.page: LSC's 2021 TIG project description page; its list is the record here
fields.release: LSC's press release announcing the round, which prints one amount (whole dollars) for each grant, grouped by state
fields.grants[].section: TIG (the page's 'Technology Initiative Grant Awards' section) or TIP (its 'Technology Improvement Project Awards' section)
fields.grants[].ap: application number as printed on the page; null where the page prints none
fields.grants[].grantee: grantee name as printed in the page's heading for the grant
fields.grants[].organization: the grantee's name as in the release and in data/awards.json, used to count organizations
fields.grants[].state: two-letter code for the grantee's state, from the release's state headings
fields.grants[].page: amount as printed on the page (a stray space inside one amount kept)
fields.grants[].release: amount the release prints for the same grant
fields.headings[]: a page heading whose grantee name differs from the name in the same grant's description and in the release
fields.statements[]: one statement by LSC about the round, quoted from the source: counts of grants and organizations (null where not given) and a dollar figure as a rule: exactly X (to the dollar) or more_than X
fields.cumulative[]: LSC's cumulative TIG figure in each year's TIG release, quoted (spaces inside numbers in the saved text removed, curly apostrophes made straight): grants since 2000 (null where the release counts 'projects' instead) and a dollar rule: more_than X or nearly X (read only as 'less than X')
fields.round_2020: the 2020 round's total as LSC's 2020 release states it, used only to read the 2020-to-2021 step in the cumulative figures
